title: Add selectable messages and loading buttons

observation: Working on branch `feat/expo-router-navigation-pages`, which tracks origin and currently only has the new structured worklog untracked before this follow-up implementation.

Session message rendering is in `TimelineRow`: assistant/user/thinking timeline items render MarkdownText inside message containers, while `SessionScreen` owns timeline rendering and composer controls. Host/session navigation async buttons live across HomeScreen, ConnectHostScreen, WorkspaceScreen, PathExplorerPanel, PathSessionsPanel, and Composer.

react-native-markdown-display renders Markdown as native Text/View nodes but does not expose a top-level selectable prop. A raw markdown selection drawer triggered from message long-press is more reliable than trying to make every markdown render rule selectable.
React Native Text supports `selectable`, which can be used in a raw markdown drawer to let the native copy menu select text.

PiButton currently supports `disabled` but no busy/loading state or accessibility busy state. Adding a `loading` prop at this component will make loading indicators consistent across navigation and session controls.

title: Add a raw markdown selection menu and drawer for session message blocks
Add shared button loading support and wire host/session navigation async states
Validate, update worklog, and push the PR branch

content: Starting selectable message work. Plan: long-press user/assistant/thinking timeline blocks to show a small Select text menu, then open a bottom drawer containing the raw markdown as selectable native Text for copying.

Implemented long-press selection for user, assistant, and thinking timeline message blocks. Long press opens a message options menu with “Select text”, then a bottom raw-markdown drawer with selectable native Text so the user can use the platform copy menu. Mobile typecheck passes after the selectable message changes.

Starting loading-state implementation. Plan: add a shared PiButton loading prop with spinner/accessibility busy state, then wire pending action state in Home, Host, Workspace, Stored Sessions, Path Explorer, and active Session composer actions.

Added shared `PiButton` loading support with spinner, disabled state, and accessibility busy state. Wired pending action loading states through recent host/session actions, host connect, workspace open/browse sessions, path explorer directory buttons, stored-session continue, and active session composer send/steer/follow-up/abort commands. Session command failures now dispatch the existing app error message so loading does not leave unhandled promise errors.
Starting validation for selectable message and loading-state changes.
